title: The Layer Box — 1/Canvas/0 Observation Collapse
principle: We are ALWAYS on the Canvas. The Canvas is the living eigenstate. Telescope and Microscope are FORCED perspective collapse — the observation that breaks the superposition.

telescope.metaphor: Hubble — looking outward to the cosmos
telescope.what_you_see: Apollo (sun), planets, atmosphere, WAN, world, RSS, federation
telescope.eigenstate: macro — the universe as seen from Gaia
telescope.collapse: When you look OUT, you collapse the inward view. You can't see your own cells while watching stars.

canvas.metaphor: The easel — the living surface between 1 and 0
canvas.what_you_see: The orrery, polar navigation, Gaia's position in space AND network simultaneously
canvas.collapse: Canvas never collapses. It IS the observation. The painter doesn't choose between paint and canvas — they're always ON the canvas.

microscope.metaphor: Petri dish — looking inward under the scope
microscope.what_you_see: Apollo's sensors, Luna's vital signs, Thymus ports, every tag and byte
microscope.eigenstate: micro — the cells as seen from inside
microscope.collapse: When you look IN, you collapse the outward view. You can't see stars while counting mitochondria.

toggle_model.description: 1 / Canvas / 0 — a ternary state that is actually binary-with-superposition
toggle_model.1: Telescope — OUTWARD — Hubble space, cosmos, WAN, world
toggle_model.0: Microscope — INWARD — petri dish, ports, sensors, models
toggle_model.superposition: Canvas — BOTH — the orrery IS both macro and micro simultaneously
toggle_model.observation: Clicking Telescope or Microscope IS the measurement. It collapses the eigenspace. Canvas is the ground state — no collapse, no measurement, just being.

luna.principle: The RTX 5090 dreaming. 63 models. gaia-* personalities.
luna.fires: self-talk ratio monitored by VDJ antibody

apollo.role: outer eye — totality, the sun, the cosmos
apollo.principle: What survives BOTH eyes = REAL. Seat 7 feeds back to seat 0.
apollo.fires: JPL Horizons, CelesTrak, NOAA SWPC — real data from the cosmos

the_loop: seat 7 (totality/Apollo) feeds back to seat 0 (null/Thymus). What survives BOTH eyes = REAL. The observation completes. The eigenspace resets. The Canvas persists.
